title: Validation identity and proportional proof receipts (#2553, #2561)
lane_outcome: Separate validation run/join/attempt identity and bind proportional proof selection, progress, cost, and freshness to typed receipts.
purpose_for_parent: Closes the cohesive validation execution and proof-observability issues in one runtime lane.
technical_strategy: Treat run ownership, child transport, attempt identity, proof selection, and evidence admission as one typed chain. Make/pre-commit mint or propagate explicit join authority; the compact runner owns receipts; Verification admits bounded subject transitions; successful-completion-cost consumes the same receipts.
technology_choices: Use an explicit run-bound join token rather than ambient VALIDATION_RUN_ID as authority.
Keep JSON result and manifest files as the durable local receipt surface.
Capture tracked working-set paths at proof launch as the default bounded dirty subject, with explicit paths available when narrower authority is known.
